user.title: Connect to Envisalink
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Envisalink EVL-3/EVL-4 module. The password is the same one used to log into the Envisalink's local web page.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Envisalink at that host/port.

init.description: The installer code is optional and only needed for the field-programming console (zone types, timing, function keys). Leave it blank to keep programming disabled -- zone bypass never needs it. A real Vista panel arms and disarms by typing a user code, so set a default user code here if you don't want to pass one on every arm/disarm call.
